fieldValues.title: 7. Implementation decisions: ADRs
fieldValues.thinking_reached: srs-rust/docs/adr on origin/master holds 55 files: ADRs up to ADR-054 (052 package upgrade, 053 structured error reports, 054 fork into container) and the template. Each has a Status, Date, Supersedes and Superseded-by. ADR-048 gives the implementation layer's rules, consuming the spec charter by link: spec-first, the layer test, one way per goal, parity and mirror, decision mode, and a sixth added 2026-10-08, identifier over label in outputs. Other repos record implementation decisions as srs-context decisions or in their CLAUDE.md files.
fieldValues.tensions:
- Three stores for decisions with separate lifecycles: srs rfc-decision records, srs-programme decision records (proposed, ratified) and srs-rust ADRs (accepted), plus srs-context decision records.
- ADRs have no mode, door or cell of their own; ADR-048 says it follows the compass by link.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: - Should an ADR carry a decision mode, and should it be a programme decision record?
fieldValues.next_action: Decide the home of an implementation decision (planning).
